title: Core Artifact: evidence.json
description: Contract for a single evidence artifact in s3://onc-compbio/core-artifacts/{ONCOTREE_CODE}/{subtype}/{gene}/{dimension}/evidence.json. Produced ONCE by a batch/ job (compute), read MANY times by skills (retrieval). This is the lingua franca consumed by AgenticBoost and the knowledge graph. Refines omics_evidence.rna_expression from the v1 evidence-extraction schema. Indication uses literal AACR OncoTree codes (e.g. COADREAD, LUAD, NSCLC, PAAD, STAD) for direct cross-reference to GENIE/cBioPortal/TCGA without a translation layer. Subtype defaults to 'all' for unstratified analyses.

gene.description: Official HGNC gene symbol, e.g. SCD1.

indication.description: Canonical AACR OncoTree code (uppercase), OR the reserved sentinel TARGET_LEVEL for products with indication_scope=target_level (target-biology-*, safety-hpa-normal-tissue, safety-gnomad-constraint). OncoTree examples: COADREAD, LUAD, LUSC, NSCLC, PAAD, STAD. See https://oncotree.mskcc.org/. Decision: literal codes, no slug layer (runbook 2026-06-15). TARGET_LEVEL is the single canonical sentinel — use of any other placeholder (TARGET, ALL, GENE) is a schema violation.

oneOf.description: AACR OncoTree code for indication-scoped products.

subtype.description: Subtype slug parameterizing the indication. Default 'all' for unstratified analyses. Examples: all, CMS1, CMS4, MSS-RASmut, MSI-H. Subtype is Takeda-internal vocabulary (OncoTree doesn't enumerate molecular subtypes). Path: core-artifacts/{ONCOTREE_CODE}/{subtype}/{gene}/{dimension}/.

dimension.description: Analysis dimension (12 dimensions per the v2 spec's Dimension Inventory; expression-protein retained for backward compatibility with v1 outputs).

product_id.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED. Identifies the specific analysis product within the dimension (e.g., 'expression-rna-tumor-vs-adjacent', 'dependency-depmap-chronos'). Resolves to an entry in core-artifacts-schema/products.yaml. When present, the result payload should validate against the product's per-product result schema (products/{product_id}.result.schema.json). v2.0 evidence artifacts should populate this; v1 artifacts may omit it during the migration window.

computed_date.description: Date the batch job produced this artifact (ISO 8601).

provenance.description: Where the inputs came from and how this was computed. Mirrors the runbook's provenance.yaml contract. The catalog_refs link back to data-catalog manifest IDs — this is what makes the artifact traceable to a re-obtainable source.

source.description: Human-readable source label, e.g. 'TCGA COAD/READ + GTEx colon'.

release.description: Source release/version string, e.g. 'GDC Data Release 42' or 'OncoLand b38_gc33'.

method.description: Computation method, e.g. 'Tumor vs adjacent-normal DGE, Mann-Whitney, BH-FDR Tier 1'.

git_commit.description: Commit SHA of the batch code that produced this artifact.

parameter_hash.description: Hash of the parameter set (config) used, for staleness/repro checks.

catalog_refs.description: data-catalog manifest IDs of the datasets this artifact derived from. e.g. ['tcga-gdc-dr42', 'gtex-v10']. THIS is the lineage link back to a re-obtainable source.

result.description: The dimension-specific result payload. Required keys vary by dimension; for expression, see the expression-dimension keys below. Open object so each dimension defines its own result shape, but values must be JSON scalars/arrays (no nested compute state).

summary.description: One-to-three sentence human-readable interpretation. Directional language, not a computed score (ScholarEval-style scores are dropped per runbook).

confidence.description: Directional confidence rating, per runbook (replaces ScholarEval numeric score).

label.description: REQUIRED per runbook. 'pre-specified' = standard workflow, suitable for BLF. 'exploratory' = non-default parameters, hypothesis-generating only.

staleness.description: Release-based staleness, NOT time-based (per runbook). Stale when the source release in provenance no longer matches the canonical current release.

$comment: Per-dimension result keys (recommended, not enforced — `result` is type:object minProperties:1 to allow dimension-specific shapes). expression-rna (canonical TCGA tumor vs adjacent normal): tumor_vs_adjacent_log2fc, lfcSE, pvalue, padj, baseMean, n_tumor, n_normal, is_actionable. expression-rna OPTIONAL Tempus RWD overlay (when indication has Tempus coverage): tempus_summary: { cohort_definition, expression_unit ('log2(TPM+1)'), overall: {n_samples, mean, median, sd, q25, q75, pct_detected}, by_lot_mss, by_ras_mss, by_msi, by_cpi, by_cms, by_idas_group (Takeda strategic whitespaces — MSS_RASMut_3L+ etc., preserved as authored, not flattened), multi_axis: {cms_lot_mss, cms_ras_mss, cms_msi} }. pct_detected (% of patients with detectable expression) is RWD-specific and important. The Tempus deposit is pre-aggregated by an upstream pipeline; provenance.catalog_refs MUST cite the tempus source-release manifest in addition to TCGA. expression-protein: same columns from CPTAC DEG. dependency: chronos_score_median, lineage_selectivity, top_codependencies, n_lines_tested. mutation-profile: mutation_freq, canonical_variants, hotspot_count. survival: hazard_ratio, log_rank_p, median_survival_days. safety: gi_toxicity_risk, normal_tissue_expression (HPA), pli_score. target-biology: subcellular_location, surface_confidence, has_structure. literature: extracted-fact counts (mirrors literature_evidence in evidence_extraction_schema.yaml v1.1.0).
